sources.inspection: Official structure account read: west-facing river frontage, open courtyard, oval central stair area, brick/partial steel with stone/mortar exterior; surviving south-courtyard iron spiral stair is separate from destroyed main staircase.
Original25m structure and oval dome about11m by8m and4m high are dimension controls; copper covering is gone in the current ruin.
Official preservation account confirms retaining the post-bombing ruin rather than rebuilding original forms.
